messages:
Ari: Heads-up — Chicago DevMeet (May 18–19) confirmed. We have a 6ft table in the community row. Need to lock speaker slot, swag, lead capture, and shipping. Who can drive?
Jenna: I can own speaker submission + one-pager. Deadline for talk proposals is next Tue.
Marco: I’ll handle swag orders. What are we doing — stickers, tees, and a small giveaway?
Ari: Prefer lightweight items — sticker sheets, 100 tees (mix S-XL), and 200 USB-C cable keychains. Also want a small raffle prize (TBD).
Priya: I’ll do booth banner art + 2 posters. Need logo vector and tagline. Ari — can you drop current tagline?
Ari: Use: "Bring inference to production — faster, cheaper, reliable." Also attaching the logo: https://internal.design/redwood-logo.svg
Sam-Ops: Logistics checklist: power at table? shipping window? labor for setup? expo rules?
Ari: Power: none guaranteed. They usually have a few outlets but don’t count on it. We’ll bring a battery pack & an offline demo laptop. Shipping window: arrives 2 days before event.
Marco: For swag timeline — tees need 4 weeks lead time; stickers and keychains 10 business days. If we order tees by Apr 20 we’re good.
Jenna: Speaker — I have a draft proposal: "Scaling inference: cost-aware routing and fallbacks at Redwood". Can I get a tech review?
Marco: Ping me and Eng-runtime (I'll run it by runtime folks). Quick note: keep slides light on infra internals — focus on customer outcomes and benchmarks.
Priya: For booth layout — 6ft table center, banner behind, 2 stools, iPad for signups. I’ll mock a 1-page layout and share.
Lena: For lead capture — suggest QR code to short form + badge scanner fallback. We own a badge scanner — @Sam-Ops can you confirm charger & sync?
Sam-Ops: Charger yes. Sync requires laptop with the right app; I’ll bring it. Also need a secure method for storing leads offline until we can upload. Can we use encrypted CSV?
Ari: Yes. We should encrypt at rest. Use the company laptop with disk encryption, and upload via SSO to HubSpot when back on network.
Jenna: Who's doing the demo? We should have a 3-min pitch + 7-min deep dive. I can do pitch; Marco or someone from runtime can do deep dive.
Marco: I can do deep dive if schedules align. Also want to present a simple benchmark: 2 models with latency/cost comparison on the slide.
Priya: Swag designs almost ready. For tees, do we want full front logo or chest print + back copy? Mocking both.
Ari: Chest logo + small back copy: "Run inference, not ops." short and punchy.
expo-bot: Reminder: Speaker submissions close in 6 days. Booth add-on requests (power, tablecloth) close in 14 days.
Jenna: Thanks bot. I’ll submit the speaker proposal today.
Marco: Ordering approach: use vendor FavPrint for tees (PO from finance) and StickerMFG for stickers. I’ll create POs this week. Need cost approval for $2,400 budget?
Ari: Approve up to $3k. Keep receipts.
Sam-Ops: Shipping address template — copy this:
```
Company: Redwood Inference (c/o Events)
Address: 5123 W Halsted Ave, Suite 210, Chicago, IL 60647
Contact: Sam Ops — +1-312-555-0117
Deliver to: Loading dock, May 16 (business hours)
```
Priya: Can someone confirm tablecloth color? We have brand navy and light gray. Navy looks better with white logo.
Ari: Navy tablecloth. Also 2 branded lanyards for lead team.
Lena: I’ll build QR short form: fields = name, company, role, interest (partner/dev/procurement), opt-in checkbox. Will include a UTM so we can tie inbound.
Jenna: Webinar follow-up plan: collect leads, send "Thanks — meet Redwood at Chicago" email within 48 hrs, then invite to a short product demo webinar two weeks post-event. Who writes copy?
Ari: I’ll draft follow-up email and demo invite. Jenna — can you own scheduling the webinar?
Jenna: Yep. Tentative webinar dates: May 30 or Jun 1.
Marco: One more thing — speaker travel stipend? We normally cover flights + hotel for one speaker. Need expense approval.
Ari: Approved. Use standard travel policy.
Sam-Ops: I'll create a shared drive folder: /events/chicago-devmeet/ with checklists and packing list. Will upload a PDF with shipping label template.
Priya: Uploaded poster mock v1 to the folder. Feedback welcome.
Jenna: Quick question — lead routing rule: high-intent (request demo) => sales SDR queue; all others => marketing nurture. Agree?
Ari: Yes. Use form field 'interest' to route. Lena to add routing rules to HubSpot.
Lena: Done — will add HubSpot workflow and tag leads with event_chicago_may2026.
expo-bot: Logistics note: Table dimensions 6ft x 30in, no wall behind for community row; banner must be freestanding.
Ari: Good call. Priya — design banner to be freestanding.
Marco: ETA on PO approvals — finance needs line item details by EOD Friday.
Sam-Ops: I’ll schedule a 30-min dry run with the team on May 15 for setup + pitch runthrough. Calendar invite forthcoming.
Ari: Thanks everyone — this is shaping up. If anyone can't make the May 15 dry run, flag now. :party_parrot:
